MUTATIONS: a sound tag naming an .mp4 is shown as video for a reader that asks; with the row's extension changed, sign.mp4 stays a sound and the question's text loses sign's element (SPEC-410 R1, R3, A1)
an .mp4's element names the type video/mp4; typed video/webm, sign's element names a type its bytes are not (SPEC-410 R1, R3, A1)

a sound tag naming an .m4v is shown as video for a reader that asks; with the row's extension changed, wave.m4v is refused as a sound and the question's text loses wave's element (SPEC-410 R1, R3, A1)
an .m4v's element names the type video/mp4; typed video/webm, wave's element names a type its bytes are not (SPEC-410 R1, R3, A1)

a sound tag naming a .mov, in any case, is shown as video for a reader that asks; with the row's extension changed, turn.MOV is refused and the answer's text loses turn's element (SPEC-410 R1, R3, A2)
a .mov's element names the type video/quicktime; typed video/mp4, turn's element names a type its bytes are not (SPEC-410 R1, R3, A2)
a reader that does not ask shows no video by default; answering true, the web's reader turns sign.mp4 from a sound into an element (SPEC-410 R2, R7, A4)
the native media folder asks for video; answering false, the native document holds no video element and sign.mp4 replays as a sound (SPEC-410 R2, R5, A5)
a video is admitted under the kind video/; under audio/, no row of the video table matches, so sign.mp4 and wave.m4v are refused and named in omitted (SPEC-410 R4, A1)
the element carries native controls, the only way to start it; without them a video that never autoplays cannot be started (SPEC-410 R3, A1)
the element is held to the card's width; at max-width:none a wide video overflows the face (SPEC-410 R3, A1)
the side's elements are appended to its rewritten text; dropped, an admitted video yields no clip and no element, so it vanishes from the face (SPEC-410 R3, A1)
the routing guard's first operand: only a reader that asks routes a video name; taken as yes, the web's reader turns sign.mp4 from a sound into an element (SPEC-410 R3, R7, A4)

the routing guard's second operand: only a name in the video table is routed; taken as yes, beep.mp3 is routed, refused under the video kind and named in omitted, and the replay loses it (SPEC-410 R3, R6, A1)

the answer side collects the question's videos only when the preset replays the question; collected outside that guard, a deck that skips the question shows sign's and wave's elements before turn's (SPEC-410 R3, A2)
on the answer side the question's videos come first, in replay order; swapped, turn's element precedes sign's and wave's (SPEC-410 R3, A2)
